test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘LIFT’ is written as ‘MKGU’ and ‘HEIGHT’ is written as ‘IGKHIU’. How will ‘WEIGHT’ be written in that language?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63298a47acd53b254b8ad8e2dd6978d33df89ad763097e5b89c5add127273f64.png] 

The logic here is: All the vowels are added by 2 and all the consonants are added by 1 to get the code language of the given word.

For the word ‘LIFT’ is written as ‘MKGU’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ae12fd239c3a2b604b259320424f3a38fa62429947ba1777abdf30b40bead72.png] 

And for the word ‘HEIGHT’ is written as ‘IGKHIU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24071ee5f46d25f3d883a7fb96a338d0d5139797952550511deca8b4e83fb60c.png] 

Similarly, the word ‘WEIGHT’ is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9bb3db67d5ec24e95abe8e36cb774c8d6b16e8121cab4a379ceef7a9b96100a.png] 

Thus, the given word is written as '**XGKHIU**'

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
